name: Rhys Williams
bio:
Rhys grew up around cars, helping his dad restore classic Holdens in their garage in Christchurch. That early exposure sparked a lifelong fascination with automotive design and finish. After completing an apprenticeship in automotive painting, he honed his skills working on everything from custom hot rods to high-end European imports. He moved to Europe to pursue motorsport opportunities, joining Blau Motorsport five years ago.

Rhys is known for his meticulous approach and ability to perfectly match any color, even under the pressure of race weekend deadlines. He prides himself on ensuring the team's cars not only perform well but also look their best on the track. His experience with a variety of paint types and application techniques makes him a valuable asset, particularly when adapting to new aerodynamic packages or sponsorship livery changes. He's a bit of a lone wolf, preferring to focus intently on his work, but his dedication is undeniable.

physical.description: Rhys is of average height, with a sturdy build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always polishes his spray guns before and after each use, regardless of time constraints.
Has a collection of vintage car enamel samples that he occasionally references.
Listens to classic rock at a moderate volume while working.
